title.value: Scenario 1.1 - Retrieve GP Patient Data of person 'XXX_Cevat'

description.value:
Qualification of scenario 1.1 of the GP Patient Data Retrieve use case. See [the test file on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/MedMij:V2020.01/Huisartsgegevens_Raadplegen) for more information.
Scenario 1.1 - Retrieve Patient, EpisodeOfCare, Composition, Encounter, MedicationRequest, laboratory and diagnostic Observation, and AllergyIntolerance resources of person XXX_Cevat.
Retrieve Patient resource of person 'XXX_Cevat' and check the request

nts:include.description: Send a FHIR search on Patient, including the correct '_include' parameter
